name: HeatmapChart

props.description: Row categories, top to bottom (the y axis — weekdays). `label` is already translated.
props.name: rows

props.description: Column categories, start to end (the x axis — hours). `label` is already translated.
props.name: columns

props.description: Cell values keyed by row + column key. A cell that is absent, null, undefined or NaN is EMPTY ('no data') — never painted as a zero.
props.name: data
props.type: { row: string | number; column: string | number; value: number | null | undefined }[]

props.description: Accessible name of the figure and its grid + visible caption.
props.name: label

props.description: Paint `label` as a visible caption. Set false under a CardTitle that already says it — the caption stays sr-only so the grid keeps its name.
props.name: showCaption

props.description: Extra context prepended to the screen-reader summary.
props.name: description

props.description: CELL size tier (--chart-heatmap-cell-size-*: 24/28/32/40px) — not a canvas height. A cell never shrinks below it; when the columns do not fit, the matrix scrolls inside its own box with the row header pinned.
props.name: size

props.description: Locale-aware formatting for cell values, the tooltip, the legend ranges and the summary (e.g. `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'JPY' }`).
props.name: numberFormat

props.description: Emphasize the N highest cells with an outline ring plus a 'Top k' note in the tooltip, the cell text and the legend — never colour alone. Ties keep `data` order.
props.name: topN

props.description: Colour-scale legend (min … max, one readable range per swatch) plus the 'no data' and 'top N' keys when they apply.
props.name: showLegend

props.description: Shown when there are no rows, no columns or no cells with a value.
props.name: emptyMessage

related: CompactBarTrend — one row of values; the other dependency-free chart.
BarChart — exact comparison across a single category axis (recharts peer).
DataTable — when the reader needs to sort, filter or read exact numbers first.
tagline: DEPENDENCY-FREE rows × columns heatmap — weekday × hour revenue / order counts, cell intensity from the sequential CVD-safe --chart-heat-1..5 ramp. Empty ≠ zero (dashed outline + 'no data' text), optional top-N ring, per-cell tooltip, APG grid keyboard, the table itself is the text alternative. Needs NO recharts. Matrix / punch card / activity heatmap / busy-hours chart.
usage: DO import from the isolated entry: `import { HeatmapChart } from "@godxjp/ui/charts/heatmap-chart";` — it never links the optional `recharts` peer.

DO derive axis labels with Intl in the active locale — weekdays via `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: 'short' })`, hours via `Intl.NumberFormat(locale)` — and pass money through `numberFormat`, never a hand-built '¥' string.

DO leave a slot OUT of `data` (or pass `value: null`) when there is no measurement — a closed hour, a day before the store opened. Pass `0` only for a real zero. The two render differently (dashed outline vs filled) and read differently ('No data' vs '¥0').
DO use `topN` to call out the peak slots; the ring is a shape and the rank is text, so the emphasis survives greyscale and colour-vision deficiency.

DO retheme through the tokens: the ramp is the foundation `--chart-heat-1..5` (light + dark), geometry and cues are `--chart-heatmap-*`. NEVER tint cells from the app, add page CSS, or fake the matrix with a styled Table.
DON'T add a separate sr-only table: the matrix IS a native data table with `role="grid"` and header cells, so the visible chart and its text alternative cannot drift apart.
DON'T use it for a continuous series over time (LineChart / AreaChart) or one row of values (CompactBarTrend).
useCases: Restaurant / retail HQ: revenue or order count by weekday × hour across the chain (POS busy-hours).
Support desk: ticket volume by weekday × hour, to plan staffing.
Any categorical matrix where intensity matters more than the exact figure: store × week, region × product.
